stories.title: MPs to question North Wales Police Commissioner over UK Government’s policing shake-up
stories.summary: North Wales Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin is among four Welsh PCCs to be questioned by MPs next month over government plans to abolish elected police commissioners by May 2028. stories.title: Indoor darts venue with shop and spectator gallery planned for Connah’s Quay industrial unit
stories.summary: An industrial unit on Dock Road in Connah’s Quay could become an indoor darts venue under plans filed with Flintshire council.
